title: Tough Sunrises
summary: Unobtainable +1 morningstar with a radiant area blind.

fields.Weapon profile: Martial one-handed morningstar, 5 ft melee and Dippable. +1 to attacks. Hit for 1d8 + 1 Piercing plus Strength.
fields.Heartstopper: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Hit for 1d4 Piercing plus attack ability modifier. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Chest Trauma for 2 turns. It removes one Action, leaving Bonus Actions and Reactions available. Undead and Constructs are immune.
fields.Concussive Smash: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Deal weapon damage. Constitution save against the higher of spell save DC or weapon-action DC +2 prevents Dazed for 2 turns. Dazed strips the Dexterity AC bonus, gives Disadvantage on Wisdom saves and prevents spending Reactions. Help clears it.
fields.Tenacity: On a main-hand melee miss, optionally spend a Reaction to deal Bludgeoning damage equal to Strength modifier, minimum 1. Uses the Tenacity reaction even when the weapon’s normal hit deals Piercing.
fields.Dawnburst Strike: Action with proficiency once per Short Rest. Deal melee weapon damage plus Radiant equal to proficiency bonus. On hit, nearby creatures in a 10 ft radius including allies make a Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 or become Blinded for 3 turns. The target itself is excluded from the blind due to reported game behavior.
fields.Base value: No nominal BG3 value is listed in the pinned source.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
